description: Find the best concert key for a melody given its lowest and highest notes and a singer range (congregation A3–D5, men-led G3–C5, women-led/kids C4–F5). Tries ±6 half steps, prefers a fit closest to the middle of the range, and lists easy guitar capo shapes. Same as https://sandymusiclab.com/tools/vocal-key-finder/

written_key.description: Key the song is written in, e.g. G
